name: read-aloud
description: Reads Claude's answers aloud with a local Kokoro voice. Off by default; toggle with ctrl+x tab m or /read-aloud.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: Kokoro voice. Best male: am_michael, am_fenrir. Best female: af_heart, af_bella. /read-aloud voice male|female overrides it live.

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: Speaking speed, 1.0 is normal. /read-aloud speed faster|slower overrides it live.

lang.title: Language
lang.description: Kokoro language code (en-us, en-gb, es, fr-fr, ...). It must match the voice.

maxChars.title: Max characters
maxChars.description: Longer answers are cut at a sentence boundary before being spoken.

spokenWords.title: Spoken answer length
spokenWords.description: While read-aloud is on, Claude is asked to keep answers under this many words.
